title: Animated Date Picker
subtitle: A button that opens a calendar to pick a date or a date range.
panelClass: flex min-h-[70vh] items-start justify-center p-[3vw] max-md:p-[5vw]

descriptions.selectionMode: Pick one date, or a start and an end date. A range shows two months side by side from tablet up.
descriptions.showIcon: Shows a calendar icon in the trigger button.
descriptions.rollingText: The button label rolls to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.dateFormat: How the chosen date is written in the trigger.
descriptions.fromBehind: The calendar grows out from behind the trigger instead of appearing below it.
descriptions.contentAnimation: How the calendar appears: scales and fades, or only fades.
descriptions.startScale: Size the calendar starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.
descriptions.closeOnSelect: Closes the calendar as soon as a date is picked. For a range, once both ends are picked.
descriptions.captionLayout: What the calendar header shows: month and year dropdowns, one of them, or a plain label.
descriptions.yearsBefore: How many years before this one the year dropdown goes back. Needs a Header with a year dropdown.
descriptions.yearsAfter: How many years after this one the year dropdown goes forward. Needs a Header with a year dropdown.
descriptions.monthAnimation: How the days change when you move to another month.
descriptions.monthSlideDistance: How far the days slide when the month changes, in pixels. Needs Month animation set to Slide + fade.
descriptions.slideArrows: The month arrows nudge in the direction they move.
descriptions.hoverVariant: Style of the day highlight: filled or outline.
descriptions.hoverAnimation: How the highlight moves between days: slides or fades.
descriptions.hoverDuration: How long the highlight takes to glide between days, in seconds.
descriptions.hoverBounce: How much the highlight overshoots when gliding. 0 is no bounce.
descriptions.weekStartsOn: First day of the week shown in the calendar.
descriptions.onlyCurrentMonth: Hides days that belong to the previous or next month.
descriptions.fixedWeeks: Always shows six weeks so the calendar keeps the same height.
descriptions.disablePast: Greys out dates before today so they can't be picked.
descriptions.highlightToday: Gives today's date its own highlight.

themeDescription: Colour palette, calendar included. The selected day and range take its primary colour.
